title: Diagnosing the Performance Trade-off in Moral Alignment: A Case Study on Gender Stereotype
reasoning: The paper focuses on 'moral alignment' as a framework for regulating LLM behavior. It specifically investigates the ethical task of mitigating gender stereotypes and analyzes the trade-offs between 'helpfulness' and 'harmlessness' (fairness/morality) using established ethics-focused benchmarks like StereoSet.
